主要内容: The Royal Bank of Canada published a Form 6-K on January 20, 2012, which includes a press release detailing its 2011 financial results under International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). The document is part of the bank's regulatory filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The report is incorporated by reference into several registration statements, including Form F-3 and multiple Form S-8 filings. The press release outlines the bank's financial performance for the year 2011, providing insights into its operations and financial position under IFRS. The filing is signed by Janice R. Fukakusa, who holds the title of Chief Administrative Officer & Chief Financial Officer.
